These are recorded tutorial runs on Windows 11, R 4.4.1 and an Intel
Core i7-1365U with about 16 GiB RAM. Memory is the whole R process's peak
resident working set, including required inputs. It is not the size of the
returned result or the additional memory needed by the solver.

The [benchmark overview](Benchmark_overview.html) also includes recovered separate simulated scoring timings and memory, updated Reactome Bayesian MAGMA and full-data PoPS models with separate preparation/BLR clocks, and separately timed 22-fold PoPS validation, a controlled 40-cell scoring grid, and remaining measurement gaps.

## Database and simulated data

The simulated panel has 5,000 people and 37,991 filtered markers. Analysis
times exclude downloading, data preparation and process startup. The mapping
rows summarize three serial repeats; the other rows are single runs.

| Tutorial / operation | Threads | Time | Peak resident memory |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| [Database download and setup](Download_and_install_gact_database.html) | — | 9 min 4 s | 2.68 GiB |
| [Linear regression](Glma_linear_and_mixed_models_simulated_data.html) | 4 | 1.64 s | 153 MiB |
| Gaussian LOCO | 4 | 57.00 s | 386 MiB |
| Prior-selected LOCO | 4 | 124.12 s | 392 MiB |
| [Four regional BayesC fits and posterior sets](Finemapping_bayesian_linear_regression_simulated_data.html) | 1 | 5.48 s | 0.56 GiB |
| Genome-wide BayesC fit from prepared LD | 1 | 2.36 s | 0.81 GiB |
| Genome-wide credible-set grouping | 1 | 3.95 s | 0.52 GiB |

Regional mapping used one chain, 1,000 post-burn sweeps and 100 burn-in sweeps;
the four regions contained 850, 785, 1,091 and 1,399 markers. Its observed
time range was 5.22–6.28 s. Genome fitting used one chain and 100 sweeps without
burn-in (2.03–2.38 s); grouping took 3.83–4.16 s. The tutorial shows two-chain
calls; their separate current measurements and completion status are in the benchmark overview. The overview also records the chromosome-component glma checks. Database setup covers 2.57 GiB of transfers and retains 3.04 GiB locally, including a 0.41 GiB ZIP archive; non-ZIP files occupy 2.63 GiB. The separate genotype reference, serialized descriptor and package installation are excluded from that footprint.

## CAD and T2D

[Genetic correlation](Genetic_correlation_CAD_T2D_gcorr.html) uses the common
7,221,923-marker availability selection and stored LD scores. The reference
has 503 EUR individuals. Time excludes input loading and saving; memory is
the peak sampled during analysis with the required inputs already loaded.

| Operation | Threads | Time | Peak resident memory |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| LDSC | — | 9.3 s | 3.02 GiB |
| GNOVA | — | 6.4 s | 3.09 GiB |
| SumHer baseline | — | 12.9 s | 3.53 GiB |
| Chromosome-set LDSC preparation and fit | — | 29.9 s | 3.27 GiB |
| HESS regional preparation | 4 | 18 min 49 s | 3.18 GiB |
| HESS pair refit from compact moments | — | 3.3–3.6 s | 0.43 GiB |

The score-based fitters expose no thread argument. HESS prepared 1,702 regions
and 18,696 retained components; its two refits reused the compact moments.
Preparation and fitting are separate costs.

For the full [VEGAS gene analysis](Gene_analysis_vegas.html), 17,862 genes and
two traits shared the same regional spectra:

| Operation | Time | Peak resident memory |
| :--- | ---: | ---: |
| Marker-set LD eigenvalues | 10 min 43 s | — |
| Prepare reusable VEGAS object | 1 min 20 s | — |
| Initial two-trait VEGAS fit | 1 min 38 s | — |
| Refit from restored preparation | 1 min 11 s | — |
| Complete initial workflow, including preparation and alignment | 15 min | 5.88 GiB |

VEGAS's memory figure covers the complete worker, including input loading;
per-stage peaks were not recorded. Its preparation used four decoding threads;
gene regions and the eigensolver were serial. The complete-workflow time is
not the VEGAS fit time. Refitting excludes loading the restored preparation.

Runtimes depend on the data and settings. The native prepared-summary BLR timing, supplementary PoPS validation timings and the status of chromosome-component examples are reported in the benchmark overview. The earlier rows above retain their original settings and measurement boundaries.
